name: enchanted-diary
description: The Enchanted Diary: an immersive 3D diary that answers questions about an uploaded PDF using real, cited RAG. A fan-inspired interface concept; not an official Warner Bros. or Wizarding World product.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @enchanted/server" "npm run dev -w @enchanted/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @enchanted/shared && npm run build -w @enchanted/server && npm run build -w @enchanted/web
scripts.test:pg: docker compose up -d --wait db && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://diary:diary@127.0.0.1:5433/diary REQUIRE_PG_TESTS=1 vitest run --project server apps/server/test/serverless-db.test.ts apps/server/test/db.test.ts apps/server/test/ingest-postgres.test.ts
scripts.calibrate: RUN_LLM_EVALS=1 RUN_CALIBRATION=1 CALIBRATE_WRITE=1 vitest run --project server-evals apps/server/test/evals/rag-calibration
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build && npm run check:vercel && npm run db:migrate:build -w @enchanted/server
